launches.tagline: Low-latency trading infrastructure for fragmented digital markets
launches.body:
Hey everyone 🚀

We're Muhammad & Peter - co-founders of Sequence Markets.

**TL;DR**

Markets are becoming more fragmented than ever. New exchanges, new venues, new markets, and new contracts keep appearing every day. Finding the best price is hard enough. Expressing one trade across all of them is even harder.

Sequence lets users package one market view into one trade from one system. Under the hood, we built proprietary low-latency infrastructure, routing software, and venue connectivity so users get the speed, access, and transparency execution requires.

**Our Launch Video:** <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0CgTRZo3hPA&vq=hd1080>

❌ **The problem**

Execution is still fragmented across exchanges, onchain venues, spot markets, perps, prediction markets, and tokenized assets.

That means:

* Hopping between venues to find the best execution path
* Managing hedge legs and risk across separate systems
* Stitching together APIs, wallets, dashboards, and workflows by hand
* Poor visibility into what actually happened after the trade

The result is worse execution, more operational drag, and less control.

🐂 **The solution**

**What Sequence enables:**

* Package one market view into one trade
* Route across fragmented venues from one system
* Manage hedge legs and risk in one workflow
* Track execution reporting and improve fill quality over time
* Run via terminal + API + SDK / MCP for humans, algos, and agent workflows

**What makes this possible:**

Under the hood, we built proprietary low-latency infrastructure, routing software, and venue connectivity. On benchmark routes, our network is up to 2.5x faster than public-internet paths, and our internal latency is roughly 2 microseconds. That lets us support even latency-sensitive users like market makers, so the bottleneck is not our system.

Internal benchmark tests also show meaningful improvements in execution quality, including lower slippage and lower execution drag versus public-internet routing on benchmarked paths.

We are starting with crypto, where the pain is already real, and extending the same system across prediction markets and tokenized assets over time.

**Early proof:**

* 150+ signups in the first week after launch
* $104B in reported trading volume across the signup base
* Over $10M in test volume completed on the platform in 2 weeks

**The ask**

We're onboarding early users and would love intros to:

* Funds, market makers, and active trading teams
* Prosumers and investors trading across multiple venues
* Builders and anyone who wants to trade through AI agents, API, SDK, or MCP workflows

**Links**

**Website:** <https://sequencemkts.com>

**Contact:** [founders@sequencemkts.com](mailto:founders@sequencemkts.com)

**Book a product call:** <https://calendly.com/d/cybb-9gw-629/sequence-markets-meeting>

**Team**

Muhammad is a Waterloo engineer and former founding engineer at a unicorn who builds the low-level systems behind Sequence.

Peter was hired by the Toronto Stock Exchange at 17 and joined a $13B fund's trading team a year later.

name: Doomersion
long_description:
Doomersion (formerly Doomlingo) lets you learn languages by doomsrolling! Watch TikToks in your target language that are exactly matched to your level, and as you scroll, they get a little bit harder.

Gen-Z doomscrolls 2.5-3 hours a day, and if we bake immersion into that by only showing them viral videos in another language that are matched to their level, we can make the optimal language learning method addictive for people. Hence the name, doomersion.

The app gained ~15k downloads in the first two weeks, and power users spend ~3+ hours daily on the app. Feel free to download and try it yourself!
one_liner: Doomscroll to learn languages

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
The idea came after Mostafa spent 6 years self-studying Japanese by watching YouTube. He went deep into language learning communities and even had the most liked post in a 2 year period on r/LearnJapanese, the biggest language learning subreddit. He found that there's no app that is both fun and educational. Apps like Duolingo are fun, but there is mass frustration with them being ineffective for actual learning. The best method to language learning is immersion, or listening to native content, but that gets really boring if you don't understand any of it. \
\
Initially, he spent a year building a language learning app that let you immerse by talking to your favorite characters in other languages, like SpongeBob, Spider-Man, etc., but found that people didn’t inherently enjoy talking to AI on a day to day basis.\
\
So how to make immersion fun? Combine it with what Gen-Z DOES want to do on a daily basis: doomscrolling. And that’s how doomersion was born!

launches.tagline: Existing automation options for 3PLs are expensive and inflexible. We're building robots to change that.
launches.body:
Hi YC ! We’re Oscar and Ben and we’re building Remy AI.

**TL;DR:** we're bringing the robotics revolution to the little guy by building AI-powered robots for e-commerce 3PLs.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97934&key=user_uploads/1182398/680c2630-17bb-498d-b1d1-1ad64cf55623)

**⚠️The problem**

Warehousing to this day remains highly manual. Whether it’s for inbound receiving, picking, or even truck loading, **more than 80% of warehouses in the US** have little to no automation.

**E-commerce 3PLs** in particular suffer from this. Unlike large retailers or shippers, their inventory mix and volumes are **highly variable**, given their smaller size and greater exposure to e-commerce trends. Their contracts renew on an annual basis, their customers regularly go out of business, and the brands they work with frequently release new products.

Most of the automation out there is designed for the big players. Stacker cranes, 2D/3D shuttles, or even more recently AMR-based systems - these all only make sense to invest in above a certain scale and predictability.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97934&key=user_uploads/1182398/487a824f-d1aa-4c7b-942e-add0a872b111)

What _80% of 3PLs look like: rows of shelves of plastic totes and cardboard boxes with at best a couple conveyors._

**Why is automation so limited?** Because existing solutions are expensive ($100-150K incl. solution + installation + servicing), bulky, and inflexible. They’re usually some mechanical system + a PLC that perform one rigid task repetitively with little to no room for customisation beyond some initial configurations. As a result, most 3PLs aren’t able to leverage these and stick to manual options.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97934&key=user_uploads/1182398/d87e20be-7be0-4950-a13c-1ea2671ad916)

_Current automated packing stations: rigid mechanical systems with limited adaptability_

Yet this long tail of 3PLs is huge: 

* 70K 3PLs in the US
* $1.2 trillion global market size
* Growing at +8% per year given relentless rise of e-commerce

**✅ The solution**

**Remy AI is building flexible automation for e-commerce 3PLs.**

We deploy a robotic system that:

* Adapts to new SKUs **without needing to be re-trained or re-programmed**
* Can be dropped into **existing work stations** with minimal modifications
* Can perform **dexterous tasks** that existing robots struggle with

We leverage a versatile bi-manual mobile platform which allows our system to be deployed on a **wide range of tasks**:

* Mobile picking
* Packing stations
* Kitting
* Receiving
* …

And crucially, we do this at a **50% lower cost** than existing solutions, by replacing mechanical complexity with intelligence.

<https://youtu.be/AhbSnP8YaG0>

**🧠 How do we achieve this?**

Recent developments in ML & robotics have made it possible to bring a human level of adaptability to robots. Whereas before you’d have to use a deterministic pipeline that would map specific object morphologies to pre-determined grasps, large pre-trained robotics & vision models now enable robots to generate trajectories and grasps by themselves, adapting in real-time to changing environments.

Combined with recent advances in simulation and robot learning, we’re able to deploy highly customised systems by taking just a couple photos of the customer’s environment, generating that environment in simulation, to then fine-tune our robot to that specific deployment. Supplementing this with real world data captured at the customer’s site + a rigorous domain randomisation pipeline + our own error recovery algorithms, we’re able to deploy systems with production-grade reliability in days not months.

**🤝🧑‍💻Our team**

We’ve been working in this problem space for several years. We met 7 years ago when we were both undergrads at Oxford.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97934&key=user_uploads/1182398/a0d166e5-4cb6-4a5b-8579-89f74288a061)

**Oscar (CEO)** - AI engineer at BCGX, built ML infra for Fortune 500s, data engineer previously

**Ben (CTO)** - PhD ML Oxford, embedded systems patent pending, robotics masters

**Ask**

We’d love to chat to more e-commerce 3PLs and brands that handle their own warehouses. Reach out to us at [founders@tryremy.ai](mailto:founders@tryremy.ai). Thanks!

* **Revenue Intelligence** - Chasi pulls context from existing systems to build a complete picture of every asset, customer, and branch. Recommends what to add, remove, or reposition across locations to maximize utilization and profitability.
* **Proactive Market Intelligence** - Chasi also tracks which customers are spending more vs. less, scans permits and public filings, and pulls in hundreds of public data sources to surface opportunities before competitors do.

The true promise of AI is to create abundance. In the physical world, abundance translates to the capacity to build, move, and maintain the civilization around us. At the core of this capacity is **equipment**.

Companies spend over $680B each year on accounting services. Yet +80% of firms still rely on manual, spreadsheet-based reconciliation processes, and small business owners spend 20+ hours every week managing their books, from invoicing and expenses to reporting and taxes.

**As former CFOs and business owners, we’ve lived the problem for years:**

* Paying thousands per month for late, inaccurate books
* Scrambling to fix errors before board meetings
* Waiting weeks for sloppy month-end closes
* Chasing receipts to stay compliant

\
**Why hasn’t this been solved?**

Because bookkeeping isn’t just rules - it’s judgment. And traditional firms aren’t built to solve this with AI. But companies needed this _yesterday;_ Despite only incorporating in January, we are already active across multiple industries helping some of the most forward-looking and modern companies in everything from tech, ecommerce, florists, to digital consultants, close their books **faster**, **cheaper** and more **accurately**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97794&key=user_uploads/2342832/6a4d536d-9b7c-413f-8a3a-c909d22c5a13)

# [**👷**](https://emojipedia.org/construction-worker) Our Solution

We’re building the accounting firm we always wished existed; combining AI systems with human experts to deliver **clean books, real-time insights, and instant answers.**

**Our AI agents ingest your business context — revenue, payroll, banking, expenses, ledger, and automate the full back-office finance stack.**

Our agents categorize transactions, reconcile accounts, and surface anomalies in real time, with a human in the loop for review and accuracy.

Once the books are clean, Balance becomes the easiest way to actually _understand_ them.

Founders can dive into costs, audit subscriptions, break down revenue, and validate taxes; all from where they work (Slack, WhatsApp, email), without waiting on PDFs or parsing spreadsheets. It’s your outsourced finance function. Accurate books, responsive, and always up-to-date.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97794&key=user_uploads/2342832/87ac5371-367d-4cbb-bae8-eb78564cb10b)

# [**👬**](https://emojipedia.org/men-holding-hands) The Team

We're a team of repeat founders, CFOs, and AI engineers who built finance teams at high-growth startups and scaled vertical AI applications globally, across McKinsey and 3 YC companies.

launches.tagline: Relaunch of Fort - New Cofounder, New Form Factor, New Website
launches.body:
Strength training is gaining traction in both the longevity community and academia, where growing evidence links muscle mass and strength to lower all-cause mortality — yet existing wearables are failing to deliver a seamless strength tracking experience. Fort is **building a screenless wearable that detects strength training and fatigue** while also tracking sleep, cardio, and overall health in an all-day worn device.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98029&key=user_uploads/3343572/6f0f58e4-335c-4f2b-b2b0-bb098aa6cde3)

**Co-founder Story**: My name is Zac. I met Miranda at a squat rack in Fitness SF - a little over a year later we got engaged. I met Paul in university where we designed, built, and raced electric vehicles. Paul and I worked at Tesla for the next 4-5 yrs doing much of the same. I introduced Miranda to Paul in late 2024, knowing that he wanted to work on something new, and Fort was born. I worked on the nights/weekends with Miranda and Paul prototyping designs until Fort occupied most of my mind share, joining full time in December ‘25.

We have a tight knit team that has experience shipping hardware at scale and a strong belief that (1) improving human health is the greatest technological frontier in the age of AI and (2) consumer devices will have a meaningful impact in people’s wellness.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98029&key=user_uploads/3343572/a1b5506e-26b6-4b5b-bd45-a33ad15c50c8)

**New Form Factor**: The product we first introduced on BF (our beta prototype) has evolved to a sleeker, smarter, more mature design featuring three finishes: _Gold_, _Black_, and _Silver_ using premium materials in a form factor that disappears into your life.

Whether you are wearing it in the gym or out to dinner, we want it to be something that you actually want to wear and blend seamlessly with other jewelry but be lightweight enough to wear in the gym.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98029&key=user_uploads/3343572/197389c4-4d80-448e-9c16-8999c0029a64)

**New Website:** We’ve revamped our website explaining the use case of Fort, the value proposition centered around strength tracking capabilities “**This Wearable Actually Tracks Strength**”. In addition to detailed strength data, the Fort App also features insights into cardio, stress, and sleep, showing how they are all interconnected: “Learn how your lifestyle affects your strength, and what metrics move the needle on your strength progress”.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98029&key=user_uploads/3343572/7c19300b-5953-4a8b-8a17-db1663fb8553)

For a limited time, pre-order sales are discounted to $289 to the general public (starting $349) which includes the production device + 1 year of software. This discounted pre-order campaign will be capped at 1,000 pre-orders before we move to MSRP - [**https://www.fort.cx/#pricing**](https://www.fort.cx/#pricing)**.**

launches.title: Fort: Automatic Strength Tracking for People Who Care About Longevity
launches.tagline: Other wearables track sleep and heart rate, but underestimate or ignore muscles and strength!
launches.body:
**TLDR;** Most wearables focus on sleep and heart rate. Fort is a wearable that automatically tracks strength training, for people focused on longevity.

**We just opened pre-orders!** [**fort.cx/order**](http://fort.cx/order)

<https://youtu.be/qU0IWkdsgY4>

**Setting The Scene**

Strength training has exploded in popularity over the past decade, especially recently. Whoop’s own data shows that strength workouts on their platform [**increased 122% YoY**](https://www.whoop.com/us/en/thelocker/whoop-year-in-review-2025/?srsltid=AfmBOoqLaNJlnaNn6uXWcFH8qfuk0ZRdry97kTI07R10adtOEx1jAR5H) between 2024 and 2025. For female Oura members, strength training was the [**third most popular**](https://ouraring.com/blog/oura-member-data-reveals-top-fitness-activities-among-female-members/?srsltid=AfmBOopcf5eXLLjOArvhBtKWvDVyd_oGxHgg2pOPhG3B7e5gHl9ME4Pb) activity, behind “walking” and “housework.” People now see strength training as a critical part of their wellness routine, not just a niche hobby for gym bros.

And yet, neither Whoop nor Oura offers a strength tracking feature that actually works.

**The Problem**

If you want to track strength workouts on existing wearables, you typically need to manually log every set, rep, and exercise. There are some attempts at automatic rep and exercise detection from Garmin and third-party Apple Watch apps, but the experience of using these products is unrefined compared to cardio or sleep features.

Even after logging everything manually, wearables underestimate or ignore muscle fatigue, and lack actionable insights on how users should adapt their training to achieve their goals.

**What we're building**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97385&key=user_uploads/1251673/343e5478-aeaf-426d-98a0-b04ac5978c5d)


Fort is a wearable that measures motion and heart rate to detect exercises, reps, sets, form, and fatigue that occurs while strength training. The device is a screenless band that can be worn on the wrist, attached magnetically to workout equipment, or worn with body straps elsewhere, so we can capture movements that wrist-only wearables miss.

We also track steps, sleep, heart rate, and cardio exercise, to provide you with a comprehensive picture of your health.

You can wear Fort all day, and the battery lasts a week with normal use.

**Who it’s for**

Anyone who cares about their health and regularly does some form of strength training, like gym or pilates!

**About us**

[Paul](https://www.linkedin.com/in/paulcschneider/), [Zac](https://www.linkedin.com/in/zacvalles/), and [Miranda](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mirandanover/) are ex-Tesla engineers who worked on Cybertruck, Semi, and Cybercab. We know how to build and ship consumer hardware at scale.

**Fort is shipping starting June 2026. Pre-Order at: [https://www.fort.cx/order/](https://www.fort.cx/order/)**

Previously, we built AI products for lawyers at[ Casetext](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/542) where Ryan was CTO and Javed led AI. Javed and JP went to Harvard Law and practiced at **Fenwick** and **Cooley**. 

General Legal is an **AI-native law firm** solving commercial contracting for founders. We save founders $100s–$1000s per contract, turn around contracts in hours instead of days, and our clients love the practical, real-time guidance they get from our experienced attorneys.

<https://youtu.be/lqSrp8fNJqs>

**The scenario:** 

Congratulations! your B2B startup has its first customer ready to buy! What happens next? Your customer sends you a Cloud Services Agreement. This 30-page document is dense with complex legal terms.

You might be tempted to just sign this deal and get the revenue now. The problem is that there are often very harmful, and sometimes even company-ending, terms buried in the first turn of an enterprise contract. Some of these terms are so aggressive that VCs won’t even count the contract toward your ARR. You need a lawyer to find and negotiate those out.

At this point, most founders ask the same law firms that did their incorporation for help. These firms will charge $500–$2000 per hour, won’t estimate how many hours they’ll need to do the job, and will take days or even weeks to turn around your agreement.

What your lawyers are doing behind the scenes is a shockingly inefficient process of passing work between partners and associates over email, unassisted by AI or technology generally. It’s a highly manual process where “data-driven” means “whatever the partner thinks they saw on the last five deals.” If you look closely at the work product, you’re quite likely to [find embarrassing errors](https://general.legal/blog/your-lawyer-is-worse-than-you-think).

In short, you’re paying a lot for a poor result, delivered slowly. In the age of LLMs, this is inexcusable.

**The solution:**

General Legal is rebuilding the law firm for the AI era like Tesla rebuilt the car for the EV era. We hire top-tier attorneys and equip them with proprietary AI workflows that enable them to operate at **10× the efficiency of traditional attorneys**. This tech advantage allows allows us to offer our clients:

* **Flat, all-inclusive pricing**
  * **$500 per contract** for review services and negotiation on existing paper
* **Turnarounds in hours not days or weeks**
  * Guaranteed contract turns within **3 hours**, with typical turns delivered in **1 hour**

   
* **Highest-quality legal work**
  * Our AI workflows eliminate common contracting errors
  * Our expert attorneys spend time focused on substantive risk and providing tailored advice

**Our Ask:**

Since announcing our private preview last month, _we’ve had over 20 growth stage companies move commercial contracting to our firm._  We want more founders to run commercial legal through us. Don’t let your founder friends pay traditional law firms for routine contract review! Send them to us. We’ll _do any company’s first contract review for free_ until demo day.

Visit our [website](https://general.legal/), [email us](mailto:founders@general.legal), or [book a demo](https://calendly.com/ryan-general/general-legal-info-call).

launches.tagline: Detect and fix production issues 15x faster
launches.body:
Hey everyone! 👋

We’re [Mitch](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mitchellradhuber/) and [Shipra](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shipra-jha-9b021859/) - before Corelayer, we built data infrastructure at Goldman Sachs where we spent many late nights and weekends debugging systems that processed 100s of billions of rows a day.

**TL;DR**

When you’re on call in data-heavy, regulated industries like fintech, healthcare, or insurance, you need to inspect underlying data to debug production issues. We built a platform that monitors both infrastructure and data for anomalies and uses AI agents to debug and suggest fixes in minutes.

[Corelayer Launch Video](https://youtu.be/yFZKJ9QRrr4)

**On-call support is painful and expensive**

All engineers hate being on call. Production issues kill velocity, erode user trust, and become more and more costly as companies scale.

Fortune 100s spend **$100M+/year** on first-line-of-defense production support.

Smaller companies can’t afford to burn **scarce engineering resources** on time-consuming support and maintenance.

**The (sensitive) data problem**

If you’re a backend engineer at a fintech, you probably own a service that queries data, applies some business logic, and stores the result somewhere (i.e., a data pipeline).

When this service is running in production, you’ll see two failure modes:

1. Exceptions in logs and/or failing jobs
2. Bad data produced by your service

“Bad data” can mean anything from incorrect values to entirely missing or duplicated rows.

**This is really common** in certain products and industries, but you’re totally blind to these errors without monitoring data for anomalies and querying data while debugging.

In regulated environments where this problem is prevalent, **production data is sensitive**, which is another constraint we have to solve for.

**Corelayer solves this**

We continuously monitor logs, metrics, **and data** for anomalies and use AI agents to debug, root-cause, and suggest fixes for issues.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96772&key=user_uploads/2897480/fce0b569-7a89-41f5-8225-625e86092a04)

We also filter out false positives and group related issues to reduce alert noise.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96772&key=user_uploads/2897480/6b91dd40-c7c7-4ca9-97a4-f80eaaff537d)

Every team is different. We take feedback from human engineers so our agents learn your systems and improve over time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96772&key=user_uploads/2897480/f5384b34-039b-40f5-ba00-4c1ede356893)

Data is especially sensitive in regulated industries. We’re SOC 2 compliant, offer **BYOC and** **on-prem deployments**, flexible LLM inference options, and expose an audit trail of each step performed by the agent with citations.

**Our Asks**

Does your team deal with data or integrations and spend more time on production support than you’d like? [Let’s chat](https://cal.com/mitchrad/30min). 

Can you connect us with an engineering leader at a finserv, fintech, healthcare, or insurance company? Reach out at [founders@corelayer.com](mailto:founders@corelayer.com).

Thank you!

launches.body:
**TLDR: Booko is a pricing engine for businesses that sell time slots that uses dynamic pricing to fill more appointments during slow times (similar to how airlines and Uber price unused capacity).**

We’d love to speak with decision makers at any time-slot-based businesses that want to maximize their revenue! Booko is a great fit for any high fixed-cost business that’s selling their time. Some examples include: class-fitness studios, med-spas, tutoring centers, consultants, personal trainers, movie theaters and event venues, hair salons, accounting firms, and other appointment-based businesses with uneven demand.

Feel free to email us: [arjun@bookoapp.com](mailto:arjun@bookoapp.com) & [will@bookoapp.com](mailto:will@bookoapp.com), or find a time to chat [here](https://calendly.com/will-bookoapp/15min?month=2026-01). 

**Product Video:**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hpmFz1jo2WI>

\*\*Problem/Solution:\*\*\
Time-slot based businesses all face the same issue: **every unsold hour is $0 revenue**. Demand is often uneven, and existing tools give customers no incentive to choose those slower times.

Booko integrates with existing booking systems to automatically adjust prices and incentives based on historical utilization, real-time availability, and demand. Like airlines or Uber, we price unused capacity while staying inside the business’s existing workflows. **Early customers see around a 20% revenue lift by filling time that would have otherwise gone unsold.**

Booko works anywhere people sell their time, from fitness-studios and med-spas to tutors, consultants, and professional services.

name: Foreman
long_description:
Foreman is the all-in-one AI-powered project management platform built for construction contractors and the trade industry.
Today, contractors run complex businesses on a patchwork of tools that were never designed for construction — estimates in spreadsheets, plans in email, proposals copy-pasted from old Word docs, photos scattered across phones. Nothing talks to anything else, and the admin work never stops.
Foreman replaces that patchwork with a single platform that manages the full lifecycle of a construction job, from first estimate to final invoice. Contractors upload plans, photos, or a project description, and Foreman's AI instantly generates structured takeoffs, scoped estimates, and professional proposals — in minutes, not hours. From there, every customer record, document, permit, photo, change order, and conversation lives in one place, organized around the job.
The result: contractors spend less time buried in admin and more time building. They bid faster, manage jobs with less chaos, and close projects cleanly — without duct-taping five tools together to do it.

launches.body:
Hey everyone [👋](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand)\
I’m [Nolan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nolan-rossi/), founder of [**Scout Out**](https://www.scoutout.ai).

**TL;DR**

Residential contractors juggle dozens of moving pieces — estimates, plans, takeoffs, proposals, change orders, documents — across spreadsheets, email threads, and sticky notes. Scout Out is the all-in-one AI-powered project management platform built specifically for construction, automating the busywork so contractors can focus on building.

[**Scout Out**](https://scoutout.ai/) contractors one platform to manage every job — with AI that handles takeoffs, clients, crew, and documents in minutes, not hours.\
\
**Ask:** If you know residential contractors, remodelers, or builders drowning in admin work, we'd love an intro.

👉 Contact us at: [nolan@scoutout.ai](mailto:nolan@scoutout.ai)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/30e770cd-ac0d-4853-9d5c-40b1cb0f9615)

# [**🕺**](https://emojipedia.org/man-dancing)**The Team**

[**Nolan (Founder & CEO)**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nolan-rossi/) – triple majored in Electrical Engineering & Computer Science, Astrophysics, and Business Administration through UC Berkeley’s M.E.T. program, graduating in three years. He previously worked as a software development engineer at Amazon and ran a software consultancy he scaled to $250k in revenue. As a fourth-generation member of a family construction business, Nolan saw firsthand how difficult it is for contractors to consistently find new work — and how little time they have to sit down and bid on projects while managing active jobs. Scout Out was built to solve that problem.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/6d9cfed3-6baf-4fac-b9b7-ec2a2d99a6de)

# **❌ The Problem**

Residential contractors are running complex businesses on a patchwork of tools that were never built for construction.

* **Project management is fragmented.** Plans live in email. Estimates live in spreadsheets. Photos live on phones. Proposals get copy-pasted from old Word docs. Nothing talks to anything else.
* **Estimating is slow and error-prone.** Reading through plans, measuring takeoffs, pricing labor and materials, then assembling a professional proposal — this process takes hours and still produces mistakes. Contractors either underbid to win, or overbid to be safe, and lose anyway.
* **AI tools exist but aren't built for construction.** Generic project management software ignores the realities of field work — plan sets, per-page takeoffs, scope changes mid-build, subcontractor coordination.

  Contractors end up duct-taping tools together and paying the price in margin and stress.

**The result:** Jobs are won with incomplete bids, managed with ad-hoc systems, and closed with manual paperwork that eats hours contractors don't have.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/0cdecb42-5772-4e1d-81d1-1d7fb87db86d)

# **🙌 Our Solution: One Platform for the Entire Job**

Scout Out is a single platform that handles the full lifecycle of a construction job — from first estimate to final invoice — with AI doing the heavy lifting.

### Job & Customer Hub 🏗️

Everything lives in one place, organized around the job:

* Customer records and full contact history
* All uploads in one place: plans, photos, permits, contracts, and insurance
* Status tracking across every deliverable and milestone
* Every conversation, change order, and document tied to the right job

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/ffbb3afc-3a3e-425d-800a-23c7fc95413a)

### Instant AI-Powered Bidding ⚡

When a contractor finds a project they want, ScoutOut generates a **clean, editable quote in seconds**.

* Upload plans, photos, or a short description
* AI produces a structured estimate covering scope, labor, and materials
* Contractors can review, adjust, and send a professional bid immediately

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/cf8c8b3c-0744-4b8b-b092-16e0952bf102)

### Built for Real Contractor Workflows 🔧

ScoutOut is designed for how contractors actually work:

* No long setup or training
* Quotes are editable and contractor-owned
* Built to be used between site visits, calls, and active builds

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/f723d694-6721-4b5a-a80a-4bd39e691892)

### Built for Real Contractor Workflows 🔧

ScoutOut is designed for how contractors actually work:

launches.title: Crow - Let users control your app through chat
launches.tagline: Connect Crow's AI agent to your product, and users can type what they want instead of clicking through menus
launches.body:
# **TL;DR**

[**Crow**](https://www.usecrow.ai/) **lets users control your app through chat. Connect Crow's AI agent to your product, and users can type what they want instead of clicking through menus.**

Unlike chatbots that just answer questions, Crow connects to your APIs and data, navigates your UI, and executes actions. Deploy in under a week.

<https://youtu.be/WavAzjR0SCg?si=4mlnykEGLCGPT7S8>

**Ask**: Know VPs or founders at software companies exploring chat-based interfaces? We'd love an intro! Contact us at [aryan@usecrow.ai](mailto:aryan@usecrow.ai)

# **🌊 The Shift**

Remember when Blockbuster thought people would always drive to stores to rent movies? Then Netflix let you just click what you wanted to watch.

**The same shift is happening with software right now.**

It started with ChatGPT. Then Claude. Then every AI assistant that followed.

Users learned they could just ask for what they want, and it would happen. Write emails, search for information, generate code — all through conversation.

**Now they carry this sentiment everywhere - including your product.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96954&key=user_uploads/1919824/a48c7936-a7d8-4d97-abf5-20d2688c9191)

## **❌ The Problem**

**Your product could be the next Blockbuster.**

Not because your features aren't good. But because, your users:

* Get lost in multi-step workflows buried in nested menus
* Stare at dashboards with 47 buttons they don't understand
* Give up on features they don't even know exist

You know an AI assistant would help. Your competitors are already shipping them. Your users are asking for them.

**But building one yourself? That's where it gets hard.**

Your team estimates 6+ months to build a reliable AI assistant:

* Integrate LLMs and connect to every API endpoint in your product
* Build context pipelines and connect to numerous data sources so it understands your app
* Add guardrails so it doesn't break things
* Build observability so you can debug when it fails
* Make it secure and reliable enough for production

And even after you ship, it needs constant maintenance. Every product update means updating the AI integration.

**Getting a demo working is easy. Getting to production-ready? That's the nightmare.**

# **🔨 Our Solution**

Crow isn't just a chatbot you slap on top of your product.

Crow is AI infrastructure that plugs directly into your app — so your users can chat with your product instead of clicking through it.

### Example

Below you can see an implementation of Crow on a sample ERP application. The user is able to easily create a Customer, open their Profit and Loss page, and go back to the Customer page - without ever having to navigate the User Interface themselves.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96954&key=user_uploads/1919824/8a396d0c-0821-45df-b7ed-c753cb393437)

Most AI chatbots just answer questions. Crow takes actions — it hits your backend endpoints, clicks buttons, navigates your UI, and executes workflows.

### **Here's how it works:**

**Connect your context** 📚

Connect your data sources — files, docs, websites, or custom integrations. Crow ingests it all and understands your product.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96954&key=user_uploads/1919824/42a5bd77-f274-43f2-aed7-57914c6e4f80)

**Wire in your functionalities** 🔌 Connect via OpenAPI spec or MCP server. Crow can now call your APIs and take client-side actions.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96954&key=user_uploads/1919824/c7648181-4ace-4d47-8f11-8d13623925db)

**Define Journeys** 🛤️ Build workflows for specific scenarios.

* E.g. User asks to cancel? Crow offers alternative options to avoid cancellation, then handles cancellation if they still want out. You set the path.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96954&key=user_uploads/1919824/e381dd18-acd6-4b5f-b0d9-9747474954e5)

**Track everything** 📊 See every conversation, tool call, and action. Know what users ask for and where things break.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96954&key=user_uploads/1919824/6725a92a-6440-475e-9630-19325b310a3c)

**Deploy** ⚡ One script tag. Simple wiring in your codebase. Go live.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96954&key=user_uploads/1919824/9ceb77d1-4f5d-47d8-87b1-55f716a56d1b)

Our customers go live in **under a week** — getting an AI Assistant on their app that is faster and more reliable than what they tried building in-house.

# **🙏 Our Ask**

If you answer "yes" to any of these, we'd love your help:

* **Are you a VP / executive / founder at a software company?** We are working with companies that have 5k to 200k DAU. Let's chat about how Crow can help → [aryan@usecrow.ai](mailto:aryan@usecrow.ai) .
* **Know someone at companies like Notion, PostHog, or Shopify?** We'd love to learn from teams already building great chat interfaces
* **Are you a developer with a side project?** Try Crow for free. Connect to our MCP docs and use Claude Code or Cursor to drop Crow into your app

👉 Learn more at [**usecrow.ai**](http://usecrow.ai) or email us at [**aryan@usecrow.ai**](mailto:aryan@usecrow.ai)

Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/110243701/) and [X](https://x.com/usecrow_ai) and share this post. Your intro could help us reach the next company that needs AI in their product!

# **👥 The Team**

Aryan and Jai met on the first day of college at UC Berkeley, bonding over college football before ever writing a line of code together.

We've both worked at top AI startups building the infrastructure that powers conversational interfaces. At these companies, we transformed workflow-heavy SaaS products into chat-first experiences—wiring integrations, solving production challenges, and seeing firsthand the massive value it brought when users could chat with products instead of navigating clunky UIs.

We built Crow because we've done this transformation before and know exactly how hard it is. Now we're making it easy for everyone else.

launches.tagline: The electricity grid is the most important machine on Earth - but planning is still file chaos. One trusted model fixes it.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Grid decisions still get made across emails, spreadsheets, PDFs, GIS exports, and conflicting model versions. [Squid](https://www.linkedin.com/company/squid-energy/) ([squid.energy](http://squid.energy)) gives utilities a single, trusted model (a live, versioned grid map of substations and lines, with evidence attached) so planning is consistent, and decisions ship faster.

### **The problem**

Most grid organisations have the tools for analysis, but the _decision trail_ is fragmented:

* models live in specialist tools
* evidence lives in decks/docs/spreadsheets
* assumptions live in people’s heads

Result: slow planning cycles, endless “which version is right?”, and hard-to-defend decisions.

### **Our solution**

Squid is a workspace where the **model of the electric grid at the center**.

* **Unify** messy grid data into one coherent model (and keep it current)
* **Version** everything so changes are trackable and comparable
* **Attach evidence + assumptions** to the model, where decisions are made
* **Run repeatable workflows** for planning, connections, and network change

### **Why now**

Electrification is accelerating and the grid is the bottleneck. The old workflow - files, handoffs, static reports - doesn’t scale to the pace of change.

### **Why us**

We’re [Conor Jones ](https://www.linkedin.com/in/conorjones-energy)and [George Kolokotronis.](https://www.linkedin.com/in/george-kolokotronis/) We’ve built inside **National Grid, Octopus Energy, and AWS** - we’ve lived the pain, and we’re building the system we wish we had.

We’re looking for **design partners** at grid operators (planning, connections, modelling, GIS, asset strategy). If that’s you - or you can intro us - please reach out: [**hello@squid.energy**](mailto:hello@squid.energy)

name: BeeSafe AI
long_description:
BeeSafe AI is building the frontier model layer for social engineering defense. Cyberattacks have moved from code to conversation: attackers now use AI to carry out long-term, trust-based manipulation across SMS, voice, email, and social platforms, often inside encrypted channels where defenders cannot see, detect, or stop them.

BeeSafe changes that by deploying undercover AI agents that engage attackers directly, expose hidden infrastructure, and convert live adversarial conversations into actionable intelligence. Each engagement adds to BeeSafe's proprietary dataset of real attacker behavior and trains foundational models that continually learn about counter-persuasion, deception, and manipulation in the wild.

BeeSafe is starting in financial crime, where banks already value our data against Authorized Push Payment (APP) fraud and money laundering, but the opportunity is far broader. The same data and models that uncover mule networks today can protect consumers, secure enterprises, and strengthen governments against the next generation of AI-powered social engineering attacks tomorrow.

launches.title: BeeSafe AI — Fraud Prevention Platform for Trust-Based Scams
launches.tagline: Stopping scams before they reach your customers
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97562&key=user_uploads/3268572/9d3f5b62-fcc6-4c25-9f79-3c11e7a60a40)

**TL;DR:** BeeSafe stops scams at the source by engaging with scammers to identify and shut down the fraudulent accounts they use for their operations. We are [Ariana Mirian](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arianamirian), [Nikolai Vogler](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikolai-vogler), and [Daniel Spokoyny](https://www.linkedin.com/in/spokoyny), three PhD AI & security experts, and we pioneered the first AI system for engaging sophisticated, trust-based scammers—now we’re scaling it into a product that helps:

* **Financial Services & Crypto** detect mule accounts for AML compliance
* **Telecommunications** block suspicious inbound messages
* **Government Agencies** take down cybercriminal operations

**The Problem: The $12B Visibility Gap for Financial Institutions**

Have you ever received a text like this?

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97562&key=user_uploads/3268572/33ca436a-5f83-4652-ba59-bdba6898fb52)

This seemingly harmless message is the start of a sophisticated social engineering scam, sometimes referred to as “pig butchering”. Scammers strike up a conversation to build trust with their victims over time, eventually convincing them to authorize real-time, irreversible payments via P2P apps, crypto, or wire transfers:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97562&key=user_uploads/3268572/1e5c6c13-4a22-4cb0-840f-8bc24ec3fdc8)

$12B was reported stolen in trust-based scams like this in the US last year, according to the FTC. With multilingual LLMs, deepfakes, and voice cloning, trust-based scam losses are skyrocketing.

Financial Services, Telcos, and Government Agencies have little visibility into trust-based scams because attackers bypass traditional fraud prevention systems (e.g. behavior-based anomaly detection):

* **Off-Platform Trust Building:** Conversations are held across multiple, end-to-end encrypted platforms, leaving any one platform blind
* **Authorized Transactions:** Victims are manipulated over time into trusting the attackers so they authorize transactions
* **Reactive Investigations:** Enterprises only know about the scams after a victim reports lost money (if they report it at all)

**The Solution: AI-Powered Scam Disruption**

Instead of blocking scammers, our system intercepts and engages with them to extract intelligence, including financial mule accounts, fraudulent assets, malicious domains, crypto drainers, and other related infrastructure.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97562&key=user_uploads/3268572/59fdda02-ba50-4593-817a-68e8b7d5bca8)

Our intel’s edge:

* **Full Campaign Context:** we map the entire fraud operations, from initial message to financial exfiltration, allowing us to map patterns of attacks.
* **Verified Data:** Our intelligence represents ground truth, and is not based on a probabilistic risk score. We minimize false positives by capturing details directly from the attackers.
* **Real Time-Discovery:** all attacker infrastructure is discovered in real-time, preventing real-victim losses.

We provide instant access to high-fidelity fraud signals for B2B and deliver this to our customers in a way that does not add any friction to everyday users.

We have already enabled financial services and government agencies to identify and intercept scammers pre-transaction to prevent victim losses, with 10,000s of real scammer conversations across communication channels, and 1,000s of mule accounts + linked infrastructure already.

**Our asks:**

If your organization and customers are facing trust-based fraud, we want to meet and see how BeeSafe can help.

Please reach out if you work in

* anti-fraud, anti-money laundering, or compliance organization
* consumer-facing fintechs, crypto exchanges, or telcos

by sending us a message at [founders@beesafe.ai](mailto:founders@beesafe.ai) or visiting [beesafe.ai](http://beesafe.ai) to learn more.

**About Us:** We are [Ariana Mirian](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arianamirian), [Nikolai Vogler](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikolai-vogler), and [Daniel Spokoyny](https://www.linkedin.com/in/spokoyny) a team of three PhD founders from Carnegie Mellon and UC San Diego. We wrote the paper that introduced the first AI system for sophisticated, trust-based scams. We bring expertise in building AI systems for security—grounded in core machine learning research and real-world cybercrime defense—with industry research experience from Google, Microsoft, Censys, and major DoD-funded programs.

question_answers.question: How did you decide to apply to Y Combinator? What was your experience applying, going through the batch, and fundraising at demo day?
question_answers.answer: I didn’t apply for the winter batch, but after the YC partners reached out and spoke with me, it seemed like the obvious choice. The batch has been awesome so far, and I’ve learned so much. Can’t wait for what’s to come :)

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
Context bloat and inefficient LLM inputs. We preprocess inputs to remove useless tokens from the context, which results in faster, cheaper, and more accurate LLM answers.

Currently, this is not being done practically anywhere, which means billions of dollars and quadrillions of tokens are being wasted.

I decided to work on this because it is something much more fundamental than ordinary application layer companies, since it affects each one. And I like hard problems ;)

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
The vision is to optimize every LLM request in the world at the token level before it reaches a model.

Even if model labs dominate, there will still be multiple competing providers. We sit above them as a neutral efficiency layer, optimizing inputs across all models. Labs are incentivized to build bigger models and sell more tokens, not reduce usage across the ecosystem. As long as more than one lab exists, a cross-model optimization layer remains structurally defensible.

launches.title: The Token Company: Intelligent compression for LLM context bloat
launches.tagline: Intelligent compression for LLM context bloat
launches.body:
Hey everyone,I’m Otso Veisterä, founder of The Token Company (YC W26).

**TL;DR**\
We build LLM input compression using a fast machine learning model (not a generative LLM). It removes useless tokens from prompts via a drop-in API—cutting token counts, latency, and costs while improving model performance. It compresses 100k tokens in under 100ms.

<https://youtu.be/65ScMCGNPss>

**The Problem**\
Prompts bloat with redundant tokens from chat history, RAG docs, or large inputs. This wastes context windows, drives up costs, slows inference, and weakens model outputs. Heavy users face high bills and must limit context to stay affordable.

**The Solution**\
Our API compresses prompts intelligently, preserving semantic intent while stripping noise. Integration takes minutes.\
Benchmarks show accuracy gains (e.g., +2.7 percentage points on financial QA with up to 20% fewer tokens) and up to 37% faster end-to-end latency.

**My Ask**\
If you're running production LLMs and fighting context bloat, high costs, or latency, email me: [otso@thetokencompany.com](mailto:otso@thetokencompany.com)\
<https://thetokencompany.com>

We’re Mohammad and Pranav (Moda, W26). **We built monitoring & reliability for AI agents.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98435&key=user_uploads/2168306/84330bae-242e-447d-a656-800061f4b1ac)

**In production, AI agents fail silently all the time:** tool calls that error or time out, agents that claim they “did it” without actually doing it, prompt injections that cause data leakage, and long customer chats that hide the real issue. Most teams only find out after users complain, churn, or something breaks.

<https://youtu.be/aKPDhL_AE4E>

### **The problem:**

When an agent fails, the “bug” is rarely one line of code. It might be a flaky tool, a prompt regression, a bad retrieval result, or a jailbreak attempt.

But most teams still debug agents by skimming transcripts, grepping logs, and hoping they notice the real issue. Previous tools were built for clicks, not for long, messy conversations with skills, MCP’s and tools.

As agents get more autonomous, this gets worse. Small changes in prompts, tools, or integrations can cause big reliability and security problems at scale.

### **What we built:**

Moda is monitoring & reliability for AI agents. It turns conversations and tool traces into low-noise, actionable signals.

**Trace-first drilldowns:** click from a metric or alert straight into the exact messages and tool calls that caused it.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98435&key=user_uploads/2168306/6e062a13-340e-452f-9676-2bdd790d94e4)

**Conversation segmentation:** automatically splits long chats into topic segments so you can debug the right unit of work.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98435&key=user_uploads/2168306/90151d61-e51b-45da-ac29-72af5c8a31d6)

**Failure detection:** flags tool-call errors, timeouts, and “claimed it worked” runs.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98435&key=user_uploads/2168306/335d8a83-6301-4d0e-af31-a75778cbbb0e)

**Quality & safety signals:** highlights hallucinations, user frustration, and prompt injection attempts.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98435&key=user_uploads/2168306/7ee4b5f6-ddc0-47a3-9e9c-3538f6764acc)

\
**Regression tracking:** measure the impact of prompt and harness changes, and catch regressions before customers do.\
\
Want to see Moda on your agent in production? Book a quick call: [https://moda.dev](https://moda.dev)

### **About Us:**

**Mohammad** built AI agents and infrastructure at **Shopify, Notion, and Clio**, shipping systems that scaled agents to real users.

**Pranav** built data infrastructure at banks and insurance firms before diving into building AI agents at **Shopify** and **Cerebral Valley**

We both dropped out of University of Waterloo to solve what we believe to be the biggest problem in the next 10 years, AI systems are unreliable, Moda is going to solve that.

Visit us at [https://moda.dev](https://moda.dev) | [pranav@modaflows.com](mailto:pranav@modaflows.com)

**Hey YC!**

We’re [@Brandon](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2746056) and [@Wasi](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2246042/following), co-founders of [@Maven](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/31253).

We’re building the payments infrastructure that lets voice AI agents collect payments during live calls.

<https://youtu.be/GZ_e33v4B0c?si=1MvBlMWpxKHK3rx9>

---

### TL;DR

Voice AI can handle the conversation. It just can’t complete the transaction.

Maven lets voice agents collect payments during live calls with one API call.

---

### The Problem

Voice agents are being deployed across:

* Home services
* Healthcare
* Insurance
* Sales
* Collections
* And more

They can qualify leads, book appointments, and negotiate pricing.

But when a customer says, “I’m ready to pay,” everything breaks.

Adding payments today means:

* Building PCI-compliant infrastructure
* Handling sensitive card data
* Managing failed payments mid-call
* Supporting multiple gateways like Stripe, Authorize.net, and Adyen

---

### Our Solution

With a single API call, we take over secure card collection, processing, retry logic, and PCI compliance.

Card data flows directly through Maven’s PCI-compliant infrastructure, never your servers.

As voice AI becomes a large revenue channel, it needs real payment infrastructure. Maven completes the loop.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97737&key=user_uploads/2246042/31358443-35d2-4fce-93a9-e27491e8b66d)

---

---

### Our Ask

We’re looking for intros to companies or operators where payments happen over the phone, including:

* Home services (HVAC, plumbing, roofing)
* Healthcare billing and scheduling
* Insurance agencies
* Collections
* Auto services
* SMB sales teams

If you know founders or teams deploying voice AI in these areas, we’d love an intro.

### Our Vision

As AI agents handle more revenue-generating conversations across voice and other interfaces, our vision is to become the default infrastructure for all human-to-agent payment touchpoints.

👉 <https://trymaven.com>

**_Sila is an agentic workplace messaging & collaboration platform where teams and AI work as one._**\
\
Every great company in history was built on one thing: communication. Sila is an agentic workspace messaging & collaboration platform for teams and companies. Our mission is to lead human-AI communication as the standard for work.

# Problem

The communication tools we use today (Slack, Microsoft Teams, etc) were built over a decade ago for a world that no longer exists. Full of "fake work" – endless messages, notifications, context switching, AI slapped on, and pings that feel productive but never move things forward. \
\
Nearly 60% of knowledge workers are overwhelmed by their communication tools, and AI is making this worse as work speeds up and the volume of communication explodes. The gap between how teams talk and how work actually gets done has never been wider.

# Solution

We rebuilt messaging from the ground up for human-AI collaboration.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98386&key=user_uploads/2559833/147e96a6-3968-49c7-baee-173a44c2b72d)

Every AI session within your workspace is shared across your team in a Google Docs-like experience, so anyone can start, delegate, and collaborate together in real time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98386&key=user_uploads/2559833/a96dc13d-89ed-4f6e-a19c-dd3f4c224c70)

# Our Mission & Ask

Thus far, AI has changed what one person could do. Sila is on a mission to change what an entire company can do together with AI. This is what work looks like now. \
\
We’d love to make your company more efficient and move faster. **If you’re a company thinking about agentic communication, custom agents, or unsatisfied with Slack or Microsoft Team, reach out to [sila@silahq.com](mailto:sila@silahq.com)** and we’d love to talk about working together as we onboard early enterprise partners.

**Lotanna** and **James** here, co-founders at Grade (YC W26).

Grade is performance based payroll. We help companies pay workers based on results.

### 

### **Our Launch Video 🎥**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wbNeaDNaQKY>

### **The Problem ❌**

Payroll is huge. About $50T a year goes to worker pay worldwide. But most payroll systems still pay people for hours worked, even when hours do not match real output.

When companies try to pay on performance, it gets messy fast:

* The rules live in spreadsheets
* Approvals are manual
* Payouts are slow and mistakes happen

### **Our Unique Insight 💡**

Before Grade, we built, scaled, and exited 4 mobile AI apps. Creators were our main growth channel, and they helped us reach millions of users.

Paying creators was always a gamble. We paid a flat fee up front and hoped a video went viral. When we switched to paying for views instead, scaling got easy, but the tools were still spreadsheets. There was no payroll system for performance pay.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97852&key=user_uploads/1159814/0f8e12e4-c2c3-4a41-ad24-ff24b323d164)

Grade makes performance pay run like real payroll, starting with creators.

* Pay creators any way you want (flat fees, performance pay, bonused)
* We track performance and calculate payouts automatically
* Approve and pay out in bulk, we deal with all the invoices and tax complaince

Hey everyone, we're the founding team behind Canary, ex-Windsurf and Google engineers.

# **TL;DR**

[Canary](https://www.runcanary.ai) is the first AI QA engineer that understands your codebase. Built by a team of ex-Windsurf and Google engineers, Canary reads your source code to understand what your app is supposed to do, then tests it like a real user would. Teams using Canary have caught broken auth flows, slow page loads, and drifts in AI responses before users hit them. Chat with us [here](https://cal.com/runcanary/founders-canary)

<https://youtu.be/IeP7H_E8yCM>

# **The Problem**

AI coding tools have made every engineering team 5–10x faster. Code generation is a solved problem. Code validation is not.

Customer-facing incidents are up 43% year over year. PRs are bigger, code reviews still happen in file diffs, and nobody is testing real user journeys before merge. Changes that look clean in review break checkout, auth, and billing in production.

QA teams are either non-existent or underwater. Manual testing can't keep up with AI-generated code volume. E2E test suites don't scale. The gap between shipping speed and validation is widening every sprint.

# **How Canary Works**

Canary connects to your codebase to understand how your app is built — routes, controllers, validation logic, API schemas. When it runs tests, it uses your code as the reference point to verify and understand how to execute them.

**PR Testing**

Push a PR. Canary reads the diff to know what changed, uses your codebase to understand the intent behind your application and the changes, then generates and runs tests against your preview app, checking real user flows end to end.

**_Step 1: Canary analyzes your PR and comments what it found_**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97890&key=user_uploads/1465952/5a5754e8-e0f2-4c5b-bd10-fc1ab314ed3b)

**_Step 2: Canary runs tests and reports results directly on the PR_**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97890&key=user_uploads/1465952/001bd6ff-fd2b-4344-b272-e3fd630ea3d8)

**_Step 3: Click into any failed test to see exactly what broke_**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97890&key=user_uploads/1465952/d0ca3915-0fb2-4226-9f78-05647886bb46)

**_Step 4: Want a specific user flow tested? Trigger it through a PR comment_**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97890&key=user_uploads/1465952/cf303da1-9272-461e-83e6-206f45569cfb)

**Regression Testing**

Move any PR test into a regression suite for ongoing use. Or describe what you want to test in plain English on our platform.

Canary generates a full test suite from your codebase, schedules it, and runs it continuously. Regression suites also run on every PR, catching bugs from new code changes before they ship.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97890&key=user_uploads/1465952/a070c92d-dda3-47d8-8b92-a1ae26b05f3b)

# **Run Canary**

Teams using Canary have caught broken auth flows, slow page loads, and drifts in AI responses as well.

We're now working directly with engineering and product teams to customize Canary to their codebase and workflows. If your team is shipping with AI coding tools and quality feels like it's falling behind, we'd love to work with you.

Reach out at [founders@runcanary.ai](mailto:founders@runcanary.ai) or chat with us directly [here](https://cal.com/runcanary/founders-canary)

# **The Team**

The founding team comes from Windsurf and Google, with deep experience building AI coding tools, AI inference systems, and enterprise-scale infrastructure.

We've built the AI tools engineers use to ship faster. We've built the enterprise systems those tools ship into. We've built both sides, Canary sits at the intersection.

Hey! We’re [Athan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/athanzhang/) and [Brianna](https://www.linkedin.com/in/brianna-lin/), the cofounders of [Copperlane](https://www.copperlane.ai/) (YC W26).

Copperlane helps **mortgage lenders originate loans faster and eliminate intake errors**. Our AI agent Penny proactively closes loans by optimizing rate pricing, directing borrowers, and verifying docs. Loan officers receive complete files and can focus on bringing in new deals.

[Copperlane Launch Video](https://youtu.be/-7Z8CI0O-GE)

**The Problem**

It costs lenders $11,800 to originate a single mortgage. Most of that money is burned during intake:

* Loan officer labor
* Lost loans from confusing applications, back-and-forth, and bad rates
* Costly mistakes from poorly structured files

All of these issues share the same root cause: people miss things. Borrowers upload the wrong documents, and lenders have to chase down borrowers to clarify details. This happens on almost every loan, every day, across 8 million loans a year.

**Our Solution**

Copperlane is an **AI-native loan origination system** powered by our agent, Penny, who behaves like a real loan officer by:

1. Pulling borrower documents, reading them, and checking borrower loan eligibility
2. Answering borrower questions live and helping them complete the loan application correctly
3. Flagging missing documents or conflicting information and following up with borrowers
4. Generating Letters of Explanation and building context around the applicant's financial profile

Penny delivers complete, organized files to Loan Officers, so they can spend more time closing and bringing in business.

**The Team**

We’re friends from the same hometown area, and we both come from mortgage families. 

* **Athan Zhang - CEO:**

  Studied CS at Princeton. Ex-quant developer and 2x founding team at startups.

launches.tagline: Automated white glove coordination for the most complicated workflows, without the headache.
launches.body:
## Hey everyone - we’re Gobhanu and Saatvik, founders of @Vela

\
**TL;DR**\
The first scheduling agent that handles the messy reality of coordination - negotiating times, coordinating interviews, prioritizing VIPs, and managing your calendar exactly like a human EA wherever you communicate (email, messages, phone calls, etc).\
\
<https://youtu.be/j5uLJQl1iAU>

**🧩 The Problem** \
Most scheduling tools assume the world is perfect. They expect rigid time slots and instant replies. But that is not how real business happens. Real business is "Let's do early next week." Real business is a VIP client needing a slot over an internal catch-up. Real business is someone ghosting you for a week. Currently, we have three bad options:

* **The Manual Way:** Personal but a massive time-sink that distracts from deep work.
* **The "Calendly" Way:** Efficient but impersonal. It signals "my time is more important than yours" and breaks the moment you have complex constraints.
* **The Human EA:** Great, but costs $80k/year and isn't available 24/7.

**💡 The Solution** \
Now there's Vela. It is an autonomous agent built for the messy reality of coordination. It doesn't just book slots; it **negotiates** on your behalf with the white-glove service of a human executive assistant.

**How it works:**

* **The "Just CC" Workflow:** Write your message naturally: _"Looping in Vela to find a time for us next week."_ Vela parses the conversation, checks your calendar, and reaches out to the other person directly to negotiate a slot. 
* **It Knows What’s Important To You:** Vela understands social hierarchy. It knows to prioritize a client over a coffee chat without you setting specific rules.
* **It Handles Ambiguity:** You don't need to give it rigid parameters. Tell Vela "Friday evenings are free," and it understands exactly what that means.

**🔧 Traction & Story** \
We built Vela because we saw high-performing teams drowning in admin work. Today, Vela is already used by the most demanding schedulers in the world - from **Enterprise Recruiters** scheduling thousands of multi-party interviews a week to **Startup CEOs** who need white-glove coordination at scale.

**Our Team**\
We are brothers who have been building together for years. Our last startup SWIFTmfi impacted millions across 77 countries! Together we combine experience from AWS ML & Supercompute, Perplexity, BCG AI, E&Y, Wharton (Huntsman), CMU, Georgia Tech, & UChicago - Booth.

**🙌 The Ask** \
If you are or know any high-volume schedulers with complicated needs (recruiting/staffing firms, sales teams, law firms, founders etc.), we’d love to hear from you and for you to try Vela.

Visit [**tryvela.ai**](http://tryvela.ai) or email us directly at [**founders@tryvela.ai**](mailto:founders@tryvela.ai)

launches.body:
**MochaCare** ([mochacare.com](http://mochacare.com)) unlocks home care agency growth with human virtual assistants supercharged by AI. We take hiring, scheduling, or both off agencies' plates so they can spend less time drowning in ops and more time building relationships in their communities. \
\
Everything we do generates data insights that surface growth opportunities, from referral leads to sales enablement during intake calls.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98296&key=user_uploads/570409/6292e9a2-6ebc-4f33-9cf0-1e60f6c1ca3f)

\* Note: a home care agency is a company that hires and manages caregivers on behalf of people seeking care. These caregivers typically work with clients in their homes or in facilities.

We personally embed into the agencies we work with. Our AI hiring and scheduling agents handle most tasks for us, but we are always monitoring the feed and jumping in if emergencies arise.

Nick goes to bed at 3:30am and Pranav wakes up at 3:30am to guarantee 24/7 coverage.

**What problem are you solving?**

1. **Home care agency operators** want to deliver quality care to their communities, not to stay glued to their phones 24/7 handling hiring and scheduling. They’re burning out and are unable to grow their businesses.
2. **Families** want reliable care. They need to know that the best caregivers are going to show up for their loved ones at the right time and need home care agencies to be energized so they can deliver their best care. Scheduling and hiring mishaps erode the quality of care and cause service failures for these families.
3. **Caregivers** want work quickly and don’t want to deal with manual data entry. They needed their next paycheck yesterday. Our hiring agents (including AI interviewers and interview coordinators) get them through the process swiftly. Once hired, they need to know about the best shifts for them. Our scheduling agents alert them to these and help them focus more on care and less on manual tasks like shift note entry.

**Why are you working on this?**\
We were both raised by our grandparents who gave the world to us. We want to live in a world where they receive the same quality care and attention that they gave us growing up. Currently, there’s a gap between that world and where we are today.

We’ve seen this first-hand. Home care operations can fall short—Nick’s grandma recently started receiving home care and had no caregiver show up on day one. We don’t want this to happen again.

On the other side of the equation, we’ve seen agency owners with the largest hearts feel hopeless about their work. We want to uplift these people and allow them to reclaim their time, get back to delivering care, and start growing their agencies.

By helping agencies deliver care more effectively, we protect the superheroes who care for our communities and the people who they care for, like our grandmas!

**Our ask:**\
Intros to home care agencies, home health agencies, or anyone who advises seniors on care options (since these people typically know home care agencies).

Thank you for taking the time to read this!

launches.tagline: VOYGR delivers comprehensive, up-to-date information about places and local businesses 🌍
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋\
We’re Vlad and Yarik, founders of VOYGR.

Have you ever asked ChatGPT for a restaurant recommendation, only to have it suggest a place that hasn’t been open in years?

VOYGR is the most accurate API for companies to validate and enrich their place records at scale. We deliver comprehensive, up-to-date information about places and local businesses for AI apps, agents, and analytics. We also offer far richer place attributes than standard mapping APIs (for example, which sauna Justin Bieber frequents).

<https://youtu.be/Q8-SY24490o>

👥 **Team**\
Vlad knows this space inside and out – he worked on the Google Maps APIs GTM, plus firsthand customer experience from building in ridesharing and travel. Yarik has spent over a decade leading ML/search teams at Apple, Google, and Meta.

❌ **The problem**\
Real-world interactions rely on mapping data: 15M+ websites, 40% of search queries, and up to 20% of LLM prompts need local context. Yet even a simple restaurant recommendation often fails: the place may no longer exist, there’s no menu-level search, or – god forbid – you need to ask something nuanced (“what’s available that’s gluten free?”).

The gap is place data – it goes stale, and the attributes are shallow. Google Maps API comes with strict terms, but companies need flexible access, plus analytics and the ability to match against proprietary data.

✅ **Our solution**\
VOYGR keeps place data accurate and current at scale. We confirm what’s live, resolve inconsistencies, and combine rich, fresh web context like news, articles, and events. 

1. **Place validation & operating status** – Confirm a place exists and is currently operating. We detect discrepancies, rebrands, and closures.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97389&key=user_uploads/325375/d5166513-44d4-48ab-9110-038e33ccf735)

2. **Place data enrichment** – Populate and continuously enrich place records using web, social, and authoritative data sources, from foundational attributes (address, category, contacts, web presence) to operating data (hours, features, amenities, etc.).

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97389&key=user_uploads/325375/a03fce95-2f7b-4999-8781-b792590f5a6b)


🎯 **Who it’s for**\
Teams with large-scale place data and real-world ops: mapping, geospatial analytics, transportation & logistics, search/discovery apps. We support a broad range of industry workflows: transaction enrichment for banks and issuers, property indexing for real estate, site selection for retail, sales territory planning, ads measurement, and more.

🤝 **Our ask**\
We’re looking for customers and design partners who have place datasets and high freshness requirements. If you’re building anything where “local” matters, we’d love to talk!

📩 [founders@voygr.tech](mailto:founders@voygr.tech)\
🌐 [voygr.tech](http://voygr.tech)

**Maps tag places** – **VOYGR understands.**

launches.tagline: We let anyone, from anywhere, use modern payment services like digital banking, tap to pay and instant money transfer.
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

SpotPay is a global neobank that lets people spend, send and receive money anywhere in the world from a single account.

We’re building the next generation of financial services powered by modern blockchains and stablecoin technology.

<https://youtu.be/lnUMKwfnmvQ>

And SpotPay is taking off! 🚀🚀

We launched just over two months ago and today we’re already **live in 40+ countries**. On average, our TPV (Total Payment Volume) is growing **43% week over week**, and our user base is growing **27% week over week**. Along the way we’ve sat down with **country leaders, large companies and central bank governors** – all sharing a common excitement around SpotPay and the future of global payments. We’re just getting started!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98487&key=user_uploads/2963544/30c07567-701e-4b46-a7ff-a7d61fffc8aa)

**Hey, we’re Zsika and Thomas.**

We kept noticing the same thing through our lived experience. Modern financial tools continue to feel like a privilege reserved for the rich world. Even with the recent increase in remittance providers, most “innovation” simply stops at the sender side — while the receiver is still stuck with legacy ways of collecting, spending, and managing money.

So we’re building SpotPay to change that.

* SpotPay provides every user with a **verified wallet** that’s tied to their real identity. That foundation lets us issue a **SpotPay Credit Card** and integrate seamlessly with **Apple Pay / Google Pay** — even for users who don’t have a bank account in their home country.
* SpotPay also allows merchants to **accept QR code payments** – avoiding the high card processing fees and gaining access to instant payment settlements since all SpotPay payments are settled on the blockchain. For SMBs, instant settlement often means they can utilize revenue from their sales up to **24 hours faster** than they would using traditional finance and maintain healthy cash flows as a result.

**Who is SpotPay for?**

Everyone.

We believe everyone deserves access to modern financial tools — **especially the hundreds of millions** of people around the world who are still unbanked or underbanked.

Because SpotPay verifies each user with their real identity, you **do not need a traditional bank account to use it**.

Imagine sending money to your aunt in another country, and within seconds she can tap her phone to pay for coffee at a local café.

Now imagine this and countless similar scenarios multiplied across 40+ countries around the world. These are the kinds of early use cases we are already seeing.

We believe that a person’s financial life should not depend on where they live, or what banking system they happen to inherit. We’re building SpotPay to make modern money a reality for everyone, everywhere.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98487&key=user_uploads/2963544/2f7bcb62-c7e0-49c8-93d3-bae98ef6c830)

**About Us:**

**Zsika** previously worked as a tech lead and PM at **Google** on several products including **YouTube Monetization, Ads Monetization, and Google Cloud**. Zsika grew up between the Caribbean and Mexico so the solution SpotPay is building is very close to him.

**Thomas** was engineer #4 at **Brex**, where he was most recently a Principal Engineer. He has spent years building financial products and infrastructure at scale. Thomas also worked as a Software Engineer at **Google**.

**How you can help:**

📱 **Download SpotPay today!** — there’s a good chance we already support the country you’re from and the country you live in, even if those are different places :).

💬 Share this with anyone who travels, sends money internationally, or receives money across borders.

🌍 Tell us the countries where you’d like to see SpotPay next.

Download here:\
<https://join.spotpay.ai>

From SpotPay with 💜

launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We're Pavan (PK), Gunin and Nirmit – co-founders of Ritivel.

## **TL;DR**

Ritivel is an AI-native workspace for regulatory and medical writing teams at life sciences companies. Our AI agents draft CTDs, CSRs, INDs, and BLAs in minutes instead of weeks, helping drugs reach patients faster.

**Ask:** Can you introduce us to regulatory affairs leaders or CISOs at pharma companies? Contact us at [pavan@ritivel.com](mailto:pavan@ritivel.com)

<https://youtu.be/VrqJtPDy_do>

## **❌ The Problem**

Every month a drug is delayed from reaching the market costs pharma companies \~$45M in lost revenue and more importantly, delays treatment for thousands of patients who need it.

Yet regulatory teams are stuck in a painful, months-long process to create FDA submissions like CTDs, CSRs, INDs, and BLAs:

**1. Information overload** 📚 These submissions require synthesizing thousands of pages of clinical data, prior submissions, and regulatory guidance which is an overwhelming task even for experienced teams.

**2. Document hunting & version chaos** 🔄 Teams waste hours digging through SharePoint folders, juggling multiple document versions, and chasing colleagues for the right files.

**3. Endless follow-ups** 📧 Regulatory leads spend their days sending reminder emails, tracking down missing inputs, and managing status updates across teams.

**4. Manual drafting bottlenecks** ⏳ Even with all the information gathered, the first draft alone takes weeks of painstaking work by highly specialized (and expensive) regulatory writers.

---

## **🔧 Our Solution**

Ritivel deploys AI agents that transform how regulatory teams work:

**Draft the most common document types like CTDs, CSRs, INDs, and BLAs in minutes** ✍️ Our agents generate comprehensive first drafts directly in Microsoft Word, following FDA formatting requirements and pulling from your existing clinical data and prior submissions. Every data point includes citations linked back to the original source, so reviewers can verify with one click.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97327&key=user_uploads/939300/4d8b39f8-8230-4dcd-b654-c51b595d124e)
